creation.title: Create Your Player
creation.subtitle: Begin your journey from grassroots to football legend.
creation.select_club_subtitle: Review trial contracts and select your entry club.
tutorial.title: Rookie Onboarding
tutorial.step.welcome.title: Welcome to Football Life
tutorial.step.welcome.desc: Your football journey begins today. Balance your performances on the pitch with relationships, lifestyle, and media in your quest to become a legend.
tutorial.step.creation.title: Define Your Identity
tutorial.step.creation.desc: Choose your player's name, nationality, primary position, and preferred foot. Your position shapes your natural attributes and match responsibilities.
tutorial.step.signing.title: Sign Your First Contract
tutorial.step.signing.desc: Several clubs are offering you an academy trial. Review the squad status, weekly wage, and manager trust before putting pen to paper.
tutorial.step.training.title: Sharpen Your Skills
tutorial.step.training.desc: Hit the training pitch to boost your abilities. High training intensity accelerates growth but consumes energy. Keep an eye on fatigue!
tutorial.step.debut.title: Your Match Debut
tutorial.step.debut.desc: Matchday has arrived! When your opportunity strikes in the match engine, swipe to aim your passes and strikes with precision.
tutorial.step.apartment.title: Home Life & Recovery
tutorial.step.apartment.desc: Football is only half the battle. Return to your apartment to rest, recover energy, and upgrade your living environment as your wages grow.
tutorial.step.phone.title: Your Smartphone & Contacts
tutorial.step.phone.desc: Check your phone for messages from teammates, manager feedback, transfer rumors, and social opportunities that shape your reputation.
tutorial.step.completed.title: You're Ready for the Big Leagues!
tutorial.step.completed.desc: You have mastered the fundamentals of Football Life. The entire footballing world is now at your feet. Train hard, play passionately, and leave your legacy!
